sources.title: SmolLM2-135M: Private, On-Device Operational AI
sources.snippet: A 135M parameter instruction-tuned model for on-device private automation, custom task adaptation, and cost-controlled operational AI without cloud dependencies. SmolLM2-135M is a compact, Apache 2.0-licensed decoder transformer trained on 2T tokens with instruction-following, reasoning, and text-rewriting capabilities.
